limits: Checks use generated output; Cloudflare preview and custom-domain production verification are separate.
Five raw vanity fragments do not load the site stylesheet; their exact byte/metadata checks replace browser styling checks.
The 36 axe scenarios cover the nine requested pages; the 74-page reflow check covers all styled HTML pages.
Custom-domain CV email verification follows production deployment; a pages.dev preview cannot prove Scrape Shield behavior.
